title: L¹ convergence on balls of mollified indicator functions, uniformly over mollifiers of small radius
statement: Let m ∈ ℕ, F ⊆ ℝ^m measurable, R ∈ ℝ and η > 0. Then there is δ > 0 with the following property. Let ρ : ℝ^m → ℝ be continuous with ρ ≥ 0, ρ(z) = 0 whenever |z| > δ, and ∫ρ dL^m = 1. Then the mollification f(v) := ∫ρ(z)1_F(v − z) dz satisfies ∫_{B_R(0)} |f − 1_F| dL^m ≤ η. The left side is the [0, ∞]-valued integral ∫⁻ ‖f(v) − 1_F(v)‖ₑ dv, and η is read as ofReal η.
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (F : Set (Euclid m)) (R η : ℝ), MeasurableSet F → 0 < η → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ ρ : Euclid m → ℝ, Continuous ρ → (∀ z, 0 ≤ ρ z) → (∀ z, δ < ‖z‖ → ρ z = 0) → ∫ z, ρ z = 1 → ∫⁻ v in ball (0 : Euclid m) R, ‖(∫ z, ρ z * F.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (v - z)) - F.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) v‖ₑ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal η
